commit_message: Model runtime: resume outer review from salvaged Main result

edits.new:
LAST_HEAVY=""
RESUME_PENDING=0

if [[ -n "$RESUME_META" ]]; then
  if [[ ! -s "$RESUME_META" ]]; then
    echo "FEHLER: Resume-Metadaten fehlen: $RESUME_META"
    exit 42
  fi
  RESUME_PENDING=1
  echo "[PIPELINE] Resume-Metadaten erkannt: $RESUME_META"
fi

while true; do

edits.old:
echo
  echo "============================================================"
  echo "===== PIPELINE MAIN RUN ${ITERATION} ====="
  echo "============================================================"

  HERMCLAW_HANDOFF_JSON="$HANDOFF_JSON" \
  HERMCLAW_BASE_BRANCH="$CURRENT_BASE" \
  HERMCLAW_JOB_ID="$JOB_ID" \
  HERMCLAW_TASK_FILE="$TASK_FILE" \
  HERMCLAW_RUN_META="$RUN_META" \
  HERMCLAW_RUN_LOG="$RUN_LOG" \
    bash "$ROOT/model_runtime/run_main_from_handoff.sh"

  RESULT_BRANCH="$(python3 - "$RUN_META" <<'PY'
import json, sys
obj=json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8'))
print(obj['branch'])
PY
)"
edits.new:
echo
  echo "============================================================"

  if [[ "$RESUME_PENDING" == "1" ]]; then
    echo "===== PIPELINE RESUME / BESTEHENDES MAIN-ERGEBNIS ====="
    echo "============================================================"
    RUN_META="$RESUME_META"
    RESULT_BRANCH="$(python3 - "$RUN_META" <<'PY'
import json, sys
obj=json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8'))
print(obj['branch'])
PY
)"
    RESUME_PENDING=0
    echo "[PIPELINE] Resume-Branch: $RESULT_BRANCH"
  else
    echo "===== PIPELINE MAIN RUN ${ITERATION} ====="
    echo "============================================================"

    HERMCLAW_HANDOFF_JSON="$HANDOFF_JSON" \
    HERMCLAW_BASE_BRANCH="$CURRENT_BASE" \
    HERMCLAW_JOB_ID="$JOB_ID" \
    HERMCLAW_TASK_FILE="$TASK_FILE" \
    HERMCLAW_RUN_META="$RUN_META" \
    HERMCLAW_RUN_LOG="$RUN_LOG" \
      bash "$ROOT/model_runtime/run_main_from_handoff.sh"

    RESULT_BRANCH="$(python3 - "$RUN_META" <<'PY'
import json, sys
obj=json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8'))
print(obj['branch'])
PY
)"
  fi
